## Club and society bookings

The ICU team is here to help deliver (almost) any event your club or society can dream of! Think workshops, gigs, awards, fashion shows, fundraisers, karaoke nights, Mario Kart competitions, stand-up comedy shows, performances... The sky is the limit.

View all [our venues](https://www.imperialcollegeunion.org/eat-drink-shop/our-venues) to see which one will be best for your event!

For all booking enquiries, please complete our [venue booking form](https://form.jotform.com/261054255536051).

You can find additional guidance and more information on club and society event bookings at the [club and society Knowledge Base](https://imperialcollegeunion.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/folders/101000439850).

Use the [Activity Proposal Form](https://www.imperialcollegeunion.org/activities/events-trips) instead if your event involves:

- Guest speakers

- Production shows

- Use of non-ICU bar venues

- Part of a larger college-wide event

- 24-hour events

- Alumni

- External collaborators (e.g. inter-university collaborations)

- Event sponsorship

If you're unsure which form to use, contact us at icu.events@imperial.ac.uk and we'll be happy to advise.

## External hire and Imperial department bookings

With a range of unique and flexible venues, our spaces are suitable for a whole host of events, ranging from small meetings to large-scale parties, and everything in between.

Our venues have hosted awards nights, networking events, conferences, leaving parties, Christmas parties, away days, workshops, corporate celebrations and more.

View all [our venues](https://www.imperialcollegeunion.org/eat-drink-shop/our-venues) to see which one will be best for your event, or check out our hire pack below for pricing, specs and capacity.

## Beit Quadrangle

![](https://www.imperialcollegeunion.org/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2Fk7lmfnyj%2Fproduction%2F50313025447080b765f4254af77569cba26432c1-6959x4639.jpg%3Frect%3D0%2C725%2C6959%2C3914%26w%3D1024%26h%3D576%26q%3D75%26auto%3Dformat&w=2048&q=75)

Beit Quad in South Kensington campus is home to the Imperial College Union building. It's next to the Royal Albert Hall on Prince Consort Road. You can find it on the [campus map](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/media/imperial-college/visit/public/SouthKensingtonCampus.pdf).

Beit Quad hosts three of our venues: **FiveSixEight, The Union Bar** and **Metric**. These three iconic spaces are known as our **Beit bars**. They open up straight out onto the quad where you can sit in the sunshine or find covered outdoor seating, depending on the season.

Our Beit bars are steeped in history, with some world-class artists such as Queen, Elton John, Led Zeppelin, and David Bowie performing at the Union!

## The Union Bar

The Union Bar is one for fans of an old-school vibe. It's a historic space with a traditional pub feel, and has been left relatively unchanged since the ICU's founding! Soak up the history with a round of darts and check out the displays and the union's legendary pewter tankard collection.

The Union Bar opens its doors for events and busier evenings at Beit Quad, and is available for hire. For those feeling peckish, food is available from the FiveSixEight kitchen next door.

## Metric

Metric is our biggest and boldest venue. It’s our most versatile space, with a fully stocked bar, dance floor, lighting and sound system. Its large capacity makes it the perfect place for live performances, DJs and club nights! We've hosted everything from dance workouts, art events and vintage fairs, to after-parties, club nights, and TV and movie filming in Metric!

Metric opens its doors for events and busier evenings at Beit Quad, and also screens live sport on our projectors for big matches.
